leadText:
Smile (Korean: 웃어봐 Useobwa) is the first opening theme for the Korean dub of Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl. It debuted with DP001, replacing Pocket Monsters AG. It uses footage from its corresponding Japanese opening theme, Together.

The full version of this song was used as the opening theme for the Korean dub of The Rise of Darkrai.

Smile (Korean: 웃어봐 Useobwa) is the first opening theme for the Korean dub of Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl. It debuted with DP001, replacing Pocket Monsters AG. It uses footage from its corresponding Japanese opening theme, Together.

The full version of this song was used as the opening theme for the Korean dub of The Rise of Darkrai.

==Opening animation==
===Synopsis===
A new day dawns. and are on the top of a hill. The camera lowers and the Pokémon D/P logo appears.

Ash throws a and sends out . The scene changes to Ash holding a Poké Ball in the air with Pikachu jumping up by his side. The camera then shows a Poké Ball shaking with a Pokémon inside.

Ash and his friends are riding jet skis while and jump over them and appears.

Ash and his friends are now around a campfire, and then Pikachu uses , avoiding . bites Pikachu’s tail, and then uses . Ash and his friends then chase a down a narrow alley.

The scene then changes to Team Rocket digging a hole, and then quickly changes a close-up shot of Dawn. Ash and his friends then run across the screen.

Team Rocket and Meowth looks astonished, while Ash and Brock come to find a trapped Pikachu. Team Rocket and Meowth jump up in joy.

Then, with a picture of Paul with a serious face as a background, Ash sends out , , Pikachu and , showing their moves , , , and , respectively.

Ash and Paul are fiercely looking at each other, standing with their Pokémon. Dawn sends out and , from two Poké Balls inside of capsules. Dawn and Zoey appear, and then does, smiling, with their Pokémon.

The scene changes to Pikachu using on .

Meanwhile, and are roaring, although they are in distant places; while is looking at them.
Ash, Pikachu, and Brock are sitting on a giant Poké Ball, and Dawn is sitting in front of it. They all smile.

===TV Size===

! English

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 

I inscribe my precious dream
With an expectant heart and a shining morning 
I head into a new and mysterious adventure

Passing by the road of secrets,
Running to avoid another danger
A special miracle awaits us

Even though I met you as an opponent during today’s battle
If we meet again under tomorrow’s sun
We will all become friends

Don’t be afraid if you lose the way
If you look at your heart’s map, you can find
A better road heading towards tomorrow
So smile
Brightly, more brightly
